jerusalem:

Requested as a DOUBLE-SIZE HERO CITY: target 2048x2048 image if possible, rich fine detail, city fills 88% width with generous transparent margin. Historically grounded layout: broad irregular roughly quadrilateral hilltop city, not a circular fantasy castle. Temple/Haram platform occupies the EAST/RIGHT third, a broad rectangular raised enclosure with substantial open paved space. Its octagonal Templum Domini / Dome of the Rock sits on the raised central terrace, a modest muted metal dome with small plain cross; do not emphasize an unverified glittering modern gold finish. Its exterior uses restrained pale stone and mosaic tones, NO Ottoman blue Iznik tile skin. Dense modest flat-roofed limestone houses and irregular streets occupy the western and northern quarters. Romanesque churches are accents, not an entire European town of red tiled gabled houses. Medieval wall circuit with restrained rectangular projecting towers. Thin rocky olive-dotted ground cutout underneath, no surrounding countryside panorama.

Entire silhouette and ground must fit within transparent margin. Keep the relative placement of the three major landmarks exceptionally clear.
